title: Struggling with currentRefinedValues

comments.body:
Hi! Thank you! For me the keyword "options" was the reason for my misunderstandig, cause to me it sounded like "create an array called options and set the parameters there".

Helpful would be an extended Example which shows some multidimensional options (like cssClasses).
Hi @synonymous1984, inside item template to easily see what are the options you can do item: function() {console.log(arguments)}
Closing for now. The V2 documentation tries to be more exhaustive, if it's still not enough we'll work harder :)
